notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness and has at least one level counter on it.
Joraga Treespeaker and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
description:
Activate Rex using Joraga Treespeaker's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
